title: Twist E18: Actual 3-torsion and pairing certificates
status_note: Partial local evidence, 2026-10-23; full experiment blocked and unfunded. Four actual 3-torsion/pairing/Frobenius certificate replays pass, including public P-521. Canonical extension registration, quotient/polarization identification and full formal bridge remain open. Complete raw publication awaits artifact-store credentials.
blocked_on: note:Four actual 3-torsion/pairing/Frobenius certificate replays pass, including public P-521. Canonical extension registration, quotient/polarization identification and full formal bridge remain open.
question: Do the four companion-matrix candidates lift to explicit Galois-equivariant anti-isometries on actual 3-torsion, including for public P-521 parameters?
decision_value: A verified anti-isometry enables E19. A mismatch is a specific module-to-geometry defect to resolve. Extension/resource exhaustion leaves that candidate unresolved; it does not refute existence.

resources.notes: Proposed pilot: one CPU, 4 GiB per process, 1,800 seconds per positive curve, extension degree at most 8. Preserve each attempted field and each failure. This is a cap, not an estimated runtime. Full resources remain unestimated. The nominal disk field is not an estimate; calibrate and freeze it before readiness.
